title: Final commitment: exact binary clique reformulation and certified row removal

preparer.emits: RPA 2 text (claims + 3 blocks) and request.json = the claims array; receipt preparation.json

shape.edits: 1,152 packing rows replaced by one-sided RHS-1 cliques (192 via integrality Round), 6,564 dependent equalities and 1,728 exact duplicates removed; 47,632 coefficients dropped

request_size_verdict: Artefact, not inherent. 10,984,641 of the 10,985,003 request bytes (99.997%) are three serialisations of one 242,736-pair identity projection; the claim's own content is 362 bytes of scalars (reverse, integer modes, objective, inverse). The clique family contributes zero request bytes - it appears only in the RPA as 1,536 steps and inside the 42,842,674 B of checks. The obligation counts (1,213,680 coordinate identities = 41.3% of 2,941,863 obligations, plus 769,728 domain restatements) are inherent to claiming complete-coordinate feasible-set equality plus both inverse identities; the text is format overhead that a compact identity/range declaration removes.
claims: Forward source->target: equality of mixed-integer feasible sets in all 242,736 original coordinates with pointwise objective equality, projection [i,i] over every i, inverse claim 0 (1,058,773 obligations, 1,536 steps).

Reverse target->source, integer mode: every target row, incl. 1,152 packing rows re-derived from recovered equalities and 1,728 duplicates restored from retained rows, plus 242,736 inverse-coordinate identities (1,067,065 obligations, 7,716 steps).
Reverse target->source, LP mode (input_integers=false): same rows without integrality obligations (816,025 obligations, 7,716 steps).

Coverage: all 322,248 source rows checked in both reverse directions and all 313,956 target rows forward; target LP included in source LP; no global strictness claimed from the audit's local fractional witness.
proof_encoding: RPA 2, 87,156,815 B = claims 10,985,002 B (byte-identical to request.json) + blocks 24,659,919 / 26,801,611 / 24,710,251 B; assembled RPX 53,838,719 B.
Steps 16,968: forward 1,536 = 1,152 clique Lin + 192 Int + 192 Round; each reverse block 7,716 = 6,564 recovered-equality Lin + 1,152 reverse Lin (Lin 16,776, Round 192, Return 3 in total).
Checks 2,941,863: 769,728 domain refs, 958,452 row refs, 1,213,680 Exact (projection + inverse), 3 root Exact; 42,842,674 B = 49.2% of the RPA.
Return map = 242,736 Expr entries [{"constant":"0","terms":[[i,"1"]]}] per block, 9,598,331 B each = 28,794,993 B = 33.0% of the RPA.
Verifier receipt: work 29,341,771, peak_live_facts 7,716, 0 branches, execute 1,380,897 us, total 2,036,966 us; five mutants assembled and rejected with exit 2 INVALID.
agent_manual_work: Exact MPS parse with Fraction arithmetic into full row/column dicts, including marker state, bound kinds, implicit zeros and single RHS/bound vectors.
Structure discovery: row-signature families, canonical duplicate detection (1,728), signed-incidence union-find (96 binary + 6,336 internal + 132 external components of 12 rows).
Support matching from each of the 1,152 packing rows to its unique balance equality, and an 18-pattern exhaustive check of 1,562 balance-satisfying assignments.
A local fractional witness (R3457/R6385, positive side 3/2, negative 1/2, z=1) with no global strictness claim.
Independent fixed-field re-parse of the 46.6 MB artifact comparing 242,736 columns, 1,621,136 coefficients, senses and bounds; hand-authored audit.json (3,463,688 B).

friction: Request text is ~100% projection boilerplate (10,984,641 of 10,985,003 B), restated once per claim and again as the per-block Return map; the claims array is also copied verbatim into proof.rpa.

The checks list must reproduce the verifier's internal obligation order and count; the preparer mirrors it by hand at tools/prepare_test39.py:33-50 with no API feedback, and the counts are then hard-coded in the receipt.

Edit attribution lives outside the certificate: target.mcm is the only machine-readable expression of the 8,292 deletions, while the mathematical witnesses are free-form untrusted JSON keyed by row name.

Five mutants each rewrote a full 87.2 MB RPA and assembled a 53.8 MB RPX, and INVALID was accepted on status alone - messages give a bare obligation index ('obligation 263328') or none ('INVALID missing obligation').
No compaction across claims or directions: the same projection and identity-map text is serialised six times in total (50,764,636 B of 98,141,818 B of request + RPA).
